title: Temple of the Tooth

groundCutout.basis: Within the mapped moat and built courtyard the ancient paving and controlled water level replace the coarse Copernicus roof elevations.

buildingCutout.basis: The two-storey shrine plinth follows the named OSM footprint at the centre of the temple.

terrainReference.basis: Native Copernicus datum on the paved public approach west of the arched entrance.

mapIdentity.scope: The native map fixes shrine and pavilion footprints. The mapped western wall breaks and junctions locate the arched public entrance and outline the moat.

note: Scowen’s exterior and portal views calibrate the front and octagon. Castelein records the original shrine section. The temple’s 2026 announcement documents the area and gilded finish of the current canopy.
